data.title: 牧之原翔子 · 海堤长椅的柠檬汽水
data.description: 【七里滨海堤·午后】翔子穿着浅蓝泳装外搭白色衬衫，坐在海堤长椅上把柠檬汽水递给镜头；她的长发被风吹向一侧，远处冲浪板与海鸟让这段休息显得明亮而安静。
data.action: 海堤长椅上递出柠檬汽水，长发被海风吹向一侧，安静看着明亮海岸
data.lighting: bright afternoon haze over the horizon
data.mood: 把海边的安心递到镜头前
data.promptProse: On the seawall bench, Shouko Makinohara offers her condensation-beaded lemon soda toward the viewer before taking a sip. A loose white shirt covers her pale-blue swimsuit, and a canvas tote rests beside her. Sea wind sweeps her dark hair sideways across the horizontal medium view. Bright afternoon haze softens the horizon and seabirds; sunlight shines through the soda while the bench casts a short shadow beneath the bottle.
